safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting associated abdominal pain can mischaracterize the diarrheal illness severity and differential (e.g., gastroenteritis vs. inflammatory/acute abdomen), potentially affecting escalation/return precautions. In this context it is unlikely to directly cause immediate harm but can reduce clinical decision quality.
